title: Choose a good dog walk
brief: I want a quick way to choose a dog walk based on the time I have, weather, and how energetic my dog is today.

target_population.role: urban dog owner squeezing walks between remote-work meetings
target_population.coverage_limit: single household with one dog profile; no multi-user accounts

core_task.summary: pick a recommended route for a 25-minute window and a low-energy dog
core_task.success_oracle: after setting the time budget to 25 minutes and energy to low, the recommendation panel names exactly one seeded route and lists at least one reason referencing time, weather, or energy

not_applicable_states.loading: all six seeded routes live in local JSON parsed synchronously at startup, so no pending frame ever renders between input and recommendation
not_applicable_states.validation-error: time budget and dog energy are chosen from constrained preset controls; the interface offers no free-form field that can hold an invalid value

state_recipes.empty: set the 10-minute preset with energy high; no seeded route fits both constraints, so the no-match panel with its loosen-a-filter hint shows
state_recipes.success: set the 25-minute preset with energy low and confirm; the recommendation card resolves to Willow Loop with its reasons listed
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the time-budget control shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the page at 390x844; the budget, weather, and energy controls stack above the route list

acceptance_facts: The seed data contains exactly six named walking routes with durations from 10 to 55 minutes and shade cover recorded for each route.
A 25-minute budget with the low energy setting recommends Willow Loop and never recommends a route longer than the stated budget.
Every recommendation displays at least one plain-language reason that references time, weather, or dog energy.

product_signature.mechanism: time-budget dial that filters routes by fit before ranking them
product_signature.anchor: recommendation panel in the primary column
product_signature.brief_trace: quick way to choose a dog walk based on the time I have
product_signature.counterfactual: a generic map directory without a time filter would satisfy a trail-listing brief but fails this one
product_signature.task_proof: success-state capture shows the dial at 25 minutes with a single ranked route card and its reasons

anti_goals: no GPS, geolocation, or live tracking of walks
no social feed, sharing, or community features
no live weather API; weather is a manual three-value toggle

content_seed.data_notes: all routes and the dog profile are invented; weather is a manual toggle among sunny, rain, and heat
